name: usage-lens
description: Browser and official MCP compatibility test tooling for the native Rust/Leptos Usage Lens application.

scripts.dev: python3 scripts/build_ui.py && cargo run --locked -p usage-lens -- serve --demo --port 4319
scripts.typecheck: cargo check --locked --workspace --all-targets --features usage-lens-ui/ssr && cargo check --locked -p usage-lens-ui --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features csr
scripts.lint: python3 scripts/check_static.py && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets --features usage-lens-ui/ssr -- -D warnings
